notes: v0.6.6: legacy reticulum-meshchat.service retired; MeshChatX (meshchatx.service) is now the only chat client, listening on TCP/8000 (port was 9100 in earlier releases; flipped to match legacy port so existing bookmarks work). Launcher row labelled MeshChat, Open points at :8000, Restart runs systemctl restart meshchatx.service (the route gates on service_installed and returns a helpful error if meshchatx is not installed yet). reset-audio stops meshchatx.service instead of reticulum-meshchat.service. Overlay recipe gained g90-image/systemd-units/meshchatx.service, restart-meshchatx helper, and prepare-meshchatx-dirs.sh install helper. Also adds the missing start_pavucontrol.sh / stop_pavucontrol.sh scripts (the Pavucontrol Start/Stop buttons were 500'ing because these scripts never made it into the github repo after the g90digi image diverged from the sbitx layout on 2026-08-09 — verified fixed on g90test). Same recipe as v0.6.5 — the manifest lists what should be installed; this release adds the missing unit/helper files to the overlay.
